item.title: Strava: The Nuclear Carrier Is Over Here - Come and Get It - A Pattern of leaks
item.description: A French sailor's 36-minute deck run just broadcast a nuclear carrier's real-time position in a war zone. This is not the first time Strava has done this. It will not be the last.

item.title: Amazfit T-Rex Ultra 2 Review: Out-Maps Instinct 3, Under-Prices Garmin Fenix
item.description: Detailed accuracy tests, GPS distance data, and real-world usability from weeks of use. The T-Rex Ultra 2 beats the Instinct 3 on maps and matches it on price. Here is whether it is worth your money.

item.title: KICKR HEADWIND Firmware 2.0.43: Multi-Sensor Cooling Update
item.description: Wahoo has released firmware 2.0.43 for the KICKR HEADWIND, the fan's most significant update since its 2018 launch. New sensor types are supported alongside an adaptive multi-sensor cooling mode. Here's what changed and how the update went in practice.

item.title: Pirelli P Zero Race TLR SL-R: First Impressions After 100 Miles - Their Fastest Road Tyre?
item.description: Pirelli launches its most aerodynamically advanced road tyre yet. After 100 miles on the SL-R, including back-to-back comparisons with the Continental Aero 111, here are my honest first impressions.

item.title: Garmin Connect+ Expansion: Bad News for Strength App
item.description: Garmin's Connect+ subscription is building a native strength ecosystem — and the API restrictions that blocked Hevy are no accident. We examine the technical evidence and what Garmin is planning next.

item.title: Garmin patents seek 50cm GPS accuracy, and improved battery life
item.description: Garmin has filed three patent applications describing a new antenna architecture that uses the watch case itself as the antenna. The result could mean better GPS accuracy, longer battery life, and cellular connectivity that works globally without regional variants.

item.title: Bolt 3 vs Apple Watch Ultra 3, Garmin Forerunner 965 very Long ride battery test
item.description: A 77-mile circular ride around London put three devices to the test. Apple Watch Ultra 3, Garmin Forerunner 970, and Wahoo Elemnt Roam 3 were all fully charged at the start. Here is what survived.

item.title: Athalyze: Training Analytics for Multi-Device Athletes
item.description: Athalyze merges duplicate workouts from multiple devices, consolidates health metrics, and tracks gear. Free on iPhone, iPad, and web in early access.

item.title: Type to Run Weekly Coach: AI Training Plans for Garmin
item.description: Type to Run's Weekly Coach generates adaptive running plans through a conversational interface and syncs structured workouts directly to Garmin. You report how each session felt, and the AI adjusts the following week. It demands active engagement rather than passive compliance.

item.title: Huawei Watch GT 5 Gets Major Upgrade
item.description: The standard Huawei Watch GT 5 is receiving its HarmonyOS 6 update in Europe, build 6.0.0.119 at 2.85 GB. The release brings three new watch faces, a redesigned Emotional Wellbeing app, Curve Pay support, and sport and training enhancements including trail running and Golf Mode upgrades.

item.title: London Marathon: Don't Die. How ECG Monitoring Saves Runners' Lives.
item.description: Cardiac arrest strikes roughly one in 100,000 marathon finishers, and that rate has not fallen in 23 years. An ECG chest strap monitors the electrical signals your GPS watch cannot see. Here is how to use one before and during the London Marathon to reduce your risk.

item.title: new Coros PacePro, ClimbPro and Hyrox modes to rival Garmin
item.description: COROS has released its Spring 2026 firmware update, adding Hill Alerts, Pace Strategy, and Hybrid Fitness mode across current and prior-generation hardware. The headline features bring ClimbPro-style climb guidance and terrain-adjusted race pacing to COROS watches for the first time. Here's what each feature does and how it holds up in practice.

item.title: Garmin Acquires Strava: IPO Cancelled as $2.1Bn Deal Confirmed
item.description: Garmin has acquired Strava in a $2.1Bn cash and equity deal, ending the platform's IPO. Both subscriptions will merge into a single Garmin Connect+ annual fee, with Runna continuing to operate independently. What this means for Garmin owners and competing platforms will become clear over the coming months.

item.title: [31 March] WHOOP Is Worth $10bn. Garmin Is Worth $40bn. Really?
item.description: WHOOP has closed a $575 million Series G round at a $10.1 billion valuation, putting it at one quarter of Garmin's public market value. The gap between those two numbers deserves scrutiny. This is what the funding history and the financials actually say.

item.title: Garmin Advanced Strength Feature - Detailed Evidence Emerges
item.description: Garmin is circulating a branded research survey that names eight specific neuromuscular strength features in development. The questions reveal more than Garmin likely intended. Here is a full analysis of what they disclose and what the planned features can realistically deliver.
